name: Madeleine
source: One of the suitors to the prince. Raised and bred for courtly life, Madeleine is the epitome of prim and proper; she shows little emotion, having good control of her feelings, and thus behaves accordingly to the situation at hand. Ambitious and power-hungry, Madeleine will trample anyone to become the Queen of Cordonia.
